facts.fact: The policy says the registry links its data with the NIA, NHIA, GES and other MDA databases, and shares aggregated or de-identified data with authorised MDAs for interoperability.
The policy says registry data identifies beneficiaries for several programmes, namely LEAP, NHIS and school feeding.
The policy says the registry holds the NIA Ghana Card number and links its data with NIA (ID), NHIA (health) and GES (education).
